summary: One icon from the kit's set, drawn by CSS in the ink of whatever it sits in.

name.description: Which icon: one of the names in the icons block of kit.config.json.

size.description: ui-geometry's icon sizes. md suits a control's label; full fills the control's slot.

root.note: A mark: a square box painted in the ink through the icon as a mask.

guidance.text: An icon beside a label says nothing new, so it is hidden from assistive technology. An icon that stands alone needs aria-label on the icon, or on the button around it.

notYet: An icon with more than one colour. A mask has one ink; write an inline svg for such a picture.
A change of aria-label after the icon has connected is not seen.
